scheme_name_original: 城镇职工基本医疗保险 (UEBMI)
administrator: National Healthcare Security Administration (NHSA) and local municipal HSA bureaus

membership_categories.label: Employed worker (domestic and foreign holding work permit)
Retired employee meeting minimum contribution years

contribution_rules: Jointly contributed by employer (approx 6% to 8% of wage base) and employee (2% of wage base deducted via payroll).
benefit_summary: Inpatient hospitalization coverage up to local annual ceiling (often RMB 500,000+ depending on municipality)
Personal medical account (个人账户) funded by employee contribution for outpatient consultations and pharmacy
Catastrophic illness supplemental insurance (大病保险) automatically linked to high medical costs
referral_requirements: Direct access to contracted public medical institutions (定点医疗机构). Referral required for inter-provincial direct billing (跨省异地就医直接结算备案).
administrative_procedures: Employer submits registration to local Social Insurance Bureau within 30 days of hiring.
Employee receives Social Security Card (社保卡) or activates Digital Health Insurance Code (医保电子凭证).
